display.summary: The table builder now includes the published 1.13.2b1 backup-table and user-interface fixes.
highlights: Tables settings: reorder and restore columns, edit translated labels and icons, and choose primary/secondary sorting through the shared inspector.
The shared inspector uses conditional Restore actions; reverted edits close without a false unsaved-changes prompt. Dlux tables stay behind Show system items.
Ribbon destination buttons support drag ordering that persists into real pages, including project export buttons.
Includes 1.13.2b1: paginated backup/restore histories, context-menu row actions, fixed restore density and closing the user menu for tours.
Includes 1.13.1 setup-upload, search and tour fixes. The remaining planned 1.14 Updates-card features will follow in later betas.
